implementation_pause.release_condition: The existing runtime contract must be re-reviewed against the research-verified editorial lifecycle, publication/export ownership boundary and standards profile, and provenance interoperability projection. Only a closed re-review may decide whether executable implementation can resume or a contract revision is required.

current_parent_critical_path.objective: Forensically re-review the existing BOOK-SYSTEM-INTEGRATION-PROPOSAL-RUNTIME-001 contract against all research-verified lifecycle, editorial, publication/export, Document-System ownership and provenance boundaries; classify each contract area KEEP, REFINE, REPLACE_OR_VERSION, or NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED; close any authority, staleness, rights/privacy, publication or provenance gap before allowing executable implementation.
must_check: dependency list includes the effective research-verified lifecycle/publication/provenance contracts or explicitly inherits them through an authoritative parent contract
service response intake preserves exact request/response/provider/parent-projection identity and non-success states
editorial-stage proposals cannot bypass structural/line/copy/proof responsibility and regression boundaries
Document/Export service SUCCESS, FORMAT_VALIDATED, POST_LAYOUT_PROOF_COMPLETE or external credential validation cannot imply publication authorization
external W3C PROV/C2PA data is evidence-only and cannot create a backdoor canonical write or admission path
stale/superseded provenance, source versions, artifacts and provider responses cannot advance without explicit parent revalidation
rights/privacy changes stale or reject affected proposals while preserving historical evidence
canonical mutation and lifecycle transition remain parent-owned
proposal admission creates bounded eligibility only and does not silently promote manuscript/export/publication state
existing exact-SHA qualification is not transferred to any revised contract or future implementation
required_output: rereview matrix with KEEP / REFINE / REPLACE_OR_VERSION / NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED classifications
explicit finding on whether runtime contract v1 remains implementation-ready
if changes are required, versioned successor or additive amendment rather than relabeling old evidence
exact next executable qualification objective only if release is justified
must_not_do: implement runtime code before the contract re-review closes
create A-01 qualification evidence for unreviewed or changed runtime semantics
transfer old exact-SHA qualification to a changed contract or implementation
collapse Document System implementation into Book System
treat research remediation closure as proof that the full Book System is complete

generic_continue_rule: In Book System control, Continue executes BOOK-SYSTEM-INTEGRATION-PROPOSAL-RUNTIME-001-CONTRACT-REREVIEW-001. Runtime implementation remains paused until that re-review explicitly releases it.
qualification_effect: Control-state advancement and architecture/provenance remediation closure only. No executable Integration Proposal Runtime, provenance adapter, external credential, manuscript promotion, author decision or publication authority is created by State-010.
